gmb.text: LenzKare runs eye camps at offices, apartments, schools and community halls for groups of 50 people or more. Each person gets a vision and eye power check, practical advice on screen eye strain, and guidance if they need to see an eye specialist. The World Health Organization estimates that about 1 billion people have a vision problem that could have been prevented or has not yet been addressed, very often simply uncorrected power. Clear vision means fewer headaches and less eye strain at work. Team members who need glasses get Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. HR managers, residents' associations and schools can message us on WhatsApp to plan a camp. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
